title: Six providers, one window
body: Gmail, Outlook, Zoho, Fastmail, Yahoo and ProtonMail — each in its real native interface, side by side in a single app.

title: Isolated sessions per account
body: Cookies, login state, and local storage never cross between accounts. Sign in to two Gmail accounts without the usual chaos.

title: Live unread counts, everywhere
body: Sidebar, dock, system tray and notifications stay in sync with each inbox — no need to click around to check what's new.

title: Built-in ad & tracker blocking
body: Network-level filtering quietly strips promo banners and tracking pixels. Provider domains are deliberately left untouched.

title: Dark mode follows your OS
body: Light by day, dark by night — Mailwing follows your system preference so you never have to flip a switch.

title: Notes & to-dos, right there
body: A quick scratch panel next to your inbox. Cmd/Ctrl + Shift + N opens it. Persists across launches, never leaves your device.
